question: After installing ComfyUI-Anima-2.9B-loraPatch, do original Anima (28 blocks) and Anima 2.9B (40 blocks) both still behave correctly?
method: Same prompt, same seed 645613437897959, same sampler (28 steps, cfg 3.5, euler, sgm_uniform, AuraFlow shift 3), 768x1344. The only variable is the ANIMA_LORA_REMAP state, changed by restarting the service. Original Anima used Anima/animayume_v15Base.safetensors (the model the production base workflow loads).

original_anima_patch_on_vs_off_both_lora.verdict: BIT-IDENTICAL. The patch is an exact no-op on 28-block Anima; no pixel changed.

anima_29b_patch_on_vs_off_both_lora_0_7.verdict: Decisively different. The patch is the sole cause of change on the 40-block model.

original_anima_nolora_vs_lora_1_0_patch_.verdict: Base-trained LoRAs work normally on original Anima, as before.

patch_on_server.note: On a 28-block model the patch emits no line at all - the gating branch for len(model_blocks)==28 returns silently.

side_finding: Stacking these two LoRAs at 1.0 washes the image out on original Anima too, so the over-application seen on 2.9B is a strength issue, not a patch artefact.
